SYMPTOM: Over-aggressive classifier broke daily use — curl/wget flagged for approval even for localhost health checks, and `jq '.categories | keys'` triggered compound detection because | inside single quotes matched COMPOUND_CHARS.

CAUSE 1: curl/wget moved to RISKY by security audit — wrong call for a dev tool.
CAUSE 2: COMPOUND_CHARS regex ran against raw command string without stripping quoted arguments first.

FIX 1: curl, wget, http back to SAFE_COMMANDS.
FIX 2: Strip single/double-quoted substrings before checking COMPOUND_CHARS — `command.replace(/"[^"]*"|'[^']*'/g, '')` then check for shell metacharacters.

PREVENT: When doing security audits, check against real dev workflow commands before committing. curl/wget are safe because you'd need the boss to run them anyway via Claude.
